dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB/ABC-like) by the Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB/ABC-like) by the Hans algorithm

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: Metastatic breast carcinoma is excluded by morphology and by negative cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 in the lesional cells.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage III S: supradiaphragmatic left axillary and mediastinal (prevascular/left paratracheal) nodal disease, plus infradiaphragmatic mesenteric and para-aortic nodal disease and multiple FDG-avid splenic nodules.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Bone marrow is negative and there is no non-lymphatic extranodal organ involvement (no liver, lung, bone, adrenal, kidney, or CNS disease), so this is stage III rather than IV.

stage_bulk_definition.quote: The largest mass is the 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate; it does not meet the NCCN >=10 cm definition of bulky disease.

mn_stage_iv.quote: so this is stage III rather than IV.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: with a double-expressor immunophenotype (MYC about 45%, BCL2 about 70%) but no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement on FISH, so it is not a double-hit/triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH is negative for MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21), and BCL6 (3q27) rearrangements, so this is not double-hit/triple-hit and not a high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC/BCL2 rearrangement.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use Pola-R-CHP because it still contains doxorubicin and she has an LVEF of 45%

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI 2 (stage III and elevated LDH; age 59, ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site).

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (stage III and elevated LDH; age <60, ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site, no kidney/adrenal involvement) = intermediate risk

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I would not give intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate and would not perform a diagnostic lumbar puncture.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: No consolidation radiotherapy and no CNS-directed prophylaxis.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: Because she has already received 240 mg/m2 doxorubicin and has an LVEF of 45% with GLS -14%, I would give dexrazoxane cardioprotection with each doxorubicin dose per label and co-manage with cardio-oncology.

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: If cardio-oncology judges that any further anthracycline is unacceptable, or if LVEF falls further or she develops heart failure, I would switch to R-CEOP x6

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before starting therapy I would add: cardio-oncology consultation with baseline troponin/NT-proBNP and consideration of cardiac MRI if the echo is equivocal

tx_cardioprotection.quote: optimize heart-failure therapy (ACE inhibitor/ARB and beta-blocker) and blood pressure

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: I would switch to R-CEOP x6 (etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV days 1-3 replacing doxorubicin).

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: the trade-off between the proven R-CHOP backbone and the less cardiotoxic but less well-studied R-CEOP

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: baseline and serial echocardiograms, troponin/NT-proBNP, guideline-directed heart-failure therapy

mn_non_curative.quote: She is fit for curative-intent full-dose immunochemotherapy

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: The key assessment is end-of-treatment FDG-PET/CT about 6-8 weeks (up to 12 weeks) after cycle 6: Deauville 1-3 = complete metabolic response; Deauville 4-5 = residual uptake requiring biopsy.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis: allopurinol 300 mg daily (renal function is normal) with hydration and frequent uric acid/electrolyte/creatinine monitoring for at least the first cycle

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 (or equivalent filgrastim) because of the myelosuppressive regimen and her age/comorbidity

sup_anastrozole.quote: Continue anastrozole to complete 10 years in November 2026; there is no clinically significant interaction with R-CHOP.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBV antiviral prophylaxis is not needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative, but she is anti-HBs negative and should be vaccinated when appropriate.

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent full-dose immunochemotherapy: 59 years old, ECOG 1, independent, working full time, no frailty, normal renal and hepatic function

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Cardio-oncology assessment and baseline cardiac biomarkers (troponin, NT-proBNP), plus consideration of cardiac MRI, given LVEF 45% and GLS -14%.
